 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u049/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d105bff6.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Mark the horizontal gap crossing the center of a shape: a blank row
    # with colored cells directly above and below is extended across the canvas.
    candidates = [r for r in range(1, h - 1)
                  if all(v == 0 for v in grid[r])
                  and any(v != 0 for v in grid[r - 1])
                  and any(v != 0 for v in grid[r + 1])]
    if candidates:
        # Prefer the row nearest the vertical center if multiple gaps qualify.
        r = min(candidates, key=lambda x: abs(2 * x - (h - 1)))
        out[r] = [3] * w
    return out
